blocks.text: Powder coating projects from Koojo Custom Powder Coating show what our team does every day: blasting, pretreating and coating real metal parts for manufacturers, fabricators and institutions. Since 2012 we have coated more than 10,000 items at our shop in Milton. This page is our powder coating portfolio, built so you can judge finished work before you send a part.
Every photo comes from a real job. Filter the powder coating projects below by category or open a case study for full specs.
Since 2012 · 10,000+ Items Coated · 48 Hr Turnaround · Oven 23' x 9' x 9' [confirm] · Google Rating [confirm]
What Do Our Powder Coating Projects Show?

Our powder coating projects show finished parts, the metal they started as and the process used. Each example points to the prep method, powder type and finish, so you can judge quality on evidence, not claims.

The work ranges from powder coated conveyor frames for automation lines to bollards and gates for public spaces. Most jobs combine blasting or chemical pretreatment, electrostatic application and oven curing. Comparing powder coating examples with your own part is the quickest way to judge fit.
Browse Projects by Category

Four filters narrow the gallery: Industrial, Automotive, Architectural and Specialty. Each filter groups powder coating projects by part type and links to the service page that explains that process in full.

Architectural: bollards, gates, fence posts and railings, detailed under [architectural powder coating](/services/architectural-coatings).
Specialty: one-off parts and prototypes, handled through our [specialty powder coating](/services/specialty-custom-projects) service.

blocks.text: More Parts From Our Shop Floor

Beyond the case studies, the gallery shows everyday production work: metal guards, fence posts, chutes, frame bases and general fabrications. These powder coating projects appear as captioned photos rather than full write-ups.

Powder coated machine guards, powder coated fence posts and powder coated chutes are typical repeat powder coating projects for fabricators and maintenance teams. Spot a part like yours? Mention the photo when you request a quote.
How Long Does a Project Take?

Standard jobs are turned around in about 48 hours once parts reach our shop. Larger fabrications, custom colours and complex masking take longer, so timelines vary across powder coating projects and we confirm yours when we quote.

blocks.text: Industries Behind the Work

Most of our powder coating projects come from five buyer groups: metal fabricators, manufacturers, food processors, contractors and municipal or institutional clients. Each group has its own industry page covering the finishes and lead times that matter to it.

For OEM equipment finishing, see [powder coating for manufacturers](/industries/manufacturing-automation); for weldments, see [powder coating for metal fabricators](/industries/metal-fabricators-welding-shops). Food plants can read [powder coating for food processing equipment](/industries/food-processing-equipment); site teams, [powder coating for contractors](/industries/contractors-construction) or [powder coating for municipalities](/industries/municipal-institutional).
What Each Project Record Includes

Every case study is written from shop records, not marketing copy. It lists the part, metal, size or weight, preparation, powder type, colour code and turnaround, plus powder coating before and after photos, so our powder coating projects are judged on facts.

Checks include film thickness to ASTM D7091 and adhesion to ASTM D3359 [confirm which run on every batch]. Our quality system is certified by the Absolute Bureau of Certification; see [powder coating quality assurance](/certification). For parts up to 6,000 lb, see [large part powder coating](/capabilities).
Powder Coating Projects: FAQs

These answers cover the questions buyers ask most about our powder coating projects. Pricing, turnaround and service area are answered on our [powder coating services](/services) page, so each answer below is specific to this gallery.

blocks.q: Are these photos from real Koojo jobs?
blocks.a: Yes. Every image shows powder coated metal parts finished in our own facility. We do not use stock photos, and each caption describes the actual part.

blocks.q: Can I order the same finish as a project shown here?
blocks.a: Yes. Case studies for these powder coating projects list the powder type and colour code, so quote that code on your request and we will confirm availability.

blocks.q: Why do some projects have no case study?
blocks.a: Not every job has the specs and photos a write-up needs. We publish case studies only when records are complete, so smaller powder coating projects stay in the gallery as photos.

blocks.q: What if my part is not shown in the portfolio?
blocks.a: Send it anyway. Many jobs are one-offs that never reach the gallery, and our custom powder coating work covers prototypes, art pieces and unusual parts that need custom metal finishing.

blocks.text: Have a Part Like These?

Send photos, sizes and quantity through our [quote form](/get-a-quote) for durable metal finishes. Call (905) 876-7060 or visit 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM, and add your part to our powder coating projects.
